scope: Print exact declarations and definitions; check actual derivative and harmonicity conclusions, every-direction recurrence, explicit first numerator, order-three Mellin formula for an arbitrary real-basis lattice, scalar coefficient bridge, and the TH-D1 complex-to-real exponential normalization.
output:
EI1_v1 : (∀ (ν : Fin 3 → ℕ) (k : Fin 4),
    MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous (kernelNumerator ν k) (∑ i, ν i + 1) ∧
      InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd (polyEval (kernelNumerator ν k)) univ) ∧
  (∀ (ν : Fin 3 → ℕ) (q : ℍ),
      q ≠ 0 → higherKernel ν q = (Quaternion.normSq q ^ (∑ i, ν i + 2))⁻¹ • harmonicNumerator ν q) ∧
    (∀ (q : ℍ), harmonicNumerator 0 q = star q) ∧
      ∀ (ν : Fin 3 → ℕ) (j : Fin 3) (k : Fin 4),
        kernelNumerator (ν + Pi.single j 1) k =
          normSqPoly * (MvPolynomial.pderiv j.succ) (kernelNumerator ν k) -
            MvPolynomial.C (2 * ↑(∑ i, ν i) + 4) * (MvPolynomial.X j.succ * kernelNumerator ν k)
TH1_v1 : ∀ (L : Submodule ℤ ℍ) [inst : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] (ν : Fin 3 → ℕ) (k : Fin 4),
  Odd (∑ i, ν i) →
    3 ≤ ∑ i, ν i →
      (∀ (t : ℝ),
          0 < t →
            Summable fun l => polyEval (kernelNumerator ν k) ↑l * Real.exp (-Real.pi * t * Quaternion.normSq ↑l)) ∧
        (Summable fun l => |polyEval (kernelNumerator ν k) ↑↑l| / Quaternion.normSq ↑↑l ^ (∑ i, ν i + 2)) ∧
          (Summable fun l =>
              ∫ (t : ℝ) in Ioi 0,
                ‖t ^ (∑ i, ν i + 1) *
                    (polyEval (kernelNumerator ν k) ↑↑l * Real.exp (-Real.pi * t * Quaternion.normSq ↑↑l))‖) ∧
            IntegrableOn (fun t => t ^ (∑ i, ν i + 1) * harmonicTheta L ν k t) (Ioi 0) volume ∧
              numeratorCoefficient L ν k = (realCoord k) (eisensteinCoefficient L ν) ∧
                numeratorCoefficient L ν k =
                  Real.pi ^ (∑ i, ν i + 2) / Real.Gamma (↑(∑ i, ν i) + 2) *
                    ∫ (t : ℝ) in Ioi 0, t ^ (∑ i, ν i + 1) * harmonicTheta L ν k t
def MathResearch.Fueter.realCoord : Fin 4 → ℍ →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
fun i => ContinuousLinearMap.proj i ∘SL ↑coordinateBasis.equivFunL
def MathResearch.Fueter.polyEval : RealPoly4 → ℍ → ℝ :=
fun P q => (MvPolynomial.eval ⇑(coordinateBasis.repr q)) P
def MathResearch.Fueter.kernelNumerator : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → Fin 4 → RealPoly4 :=
fun ν k => numeratorJet (spatialDerivativeList ν) k
def MathResearch.Fueter.harmonicNumerator : (Fin 3 → ℕ) → ℍ → ℍ :=
fun ν q => ∑ k, polyEval (kernelNumerator ν k) q • coordinateBasis k
def MathResearch.Fueter.numeratorCoefficient : Submodule ℤ ℍ → (Fin 3 → ℕ) → Fin 4 → ℝ :=
fun L ν k => ∑' (l : { l // l ≠ 0 }), polyEval (kernelNumerator ν k) ↑↑l / Quaternion.normSq ↑↑l ^ (∑ i, ν i + 2)
def MathResearch.Fueter.harmonicTheta : Submodule ℤ ℍ → (Fin 3 → ℕ) → Fin 4 → ℝ → ℝ :=
fun L ν k t => ∑' (l : ↥L), polyEval (kernelNumerator ν k) ↑l * Real.exp (-Real.pi * t * Quaternion.normSq ↑l)
polyEval_pderiv : ∀ (P : RealPoly4) (j : Fin 4) (q : ℍ),
  (fderiv ℝ (polyEval P) q) (coordinateBasis j) = polyEval ((MvPolynomial.pderiv j) P) q
polyEval_laplacian : ∀ (P : RealPoly4), Laplacian.laplacian (polyEval P) = polyEval (polyLaplacian P)
numeratorJet_represents : ∀ (l : List (Fin 4)) (k : Fin 4) {q : ℍ},
  q ≠ 0 →
    (realCoord k) (iteratedPartial l kernel q) = polyEval (numeratorJet l k) q / Quaternion.normSq q ^ (l.length + 2)
kernelNumerator_recurrence : ∀ (ν : Fin 3 → ℕ) (j : Fin 3) (k : Fin 4),
  kernelNumerator (ν + Pi.single j 1) k = numeratorStep (∑ i, ν i) j.succ (kernelNumerator ν k)
harmonicTheta_mellin : ∀ (L : Submodule ℤ ℍ) [inst : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] (ν : Fin 3 → ℕ) (k : Fin 4),
  2 ≤ ∑ i, ν i →
    numeratorCoefficient L ν k =
      Real.pi ^ (∑ i, ν i + 2) / Real.Gamma (↑(∑ i, ν i) + 2) *
        ∫ (t : ℝ) in Ioi 0, t ^ (∑ i, ν i + 1) * harmonicTheta L ν k t
'MathResearch.Fueter.EI1_v1' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'MathResearch.Fueter.TH1_v1' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
